name: kalshi-weather-edge
title: Kalshi Weather Edge
description: Open Kalshi daily high, low and rain bracket markets (KXHIGH*, KXLOW*, KXRAIN*) joined to the NWS and Open-Meteo forecasts for each market's settlement station: bracket bounds, close time, bid/ask/mid, order-book depth, forecast high/low/precipitation probability, a stated-sigma normal-model probability per bracket and the difference to the market mid. Descriptive data from public APIs, no login, not advice.
